reply: al bases in A and t leave NMSE around 1e-4 to 1e-5. Adding an exponential term in t or 1/t brings it to about 3e-6 to 6e-6, so the time dependence is probably not a simple polynomial. I ran out of tool calls before I could test further forms, such as a t-dependence exp(-b/t) combined with a t² term.

import numpy as np
def equation(t, A, params):
    p = params
    return (p[0] + p[1]*A + p[2]*A**2 + p[3]*A**3
            + p[4]*t*A**p[5] + p[6]*t**2
            + p[7]*np.exp(-p[8]/t)*A**p[9])
